name: Campofrío (Spain)
description: Green field with a large white lozenge throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Campofrío (crossed keys and a book on green).
history: Municipal flag of Campofrío; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Campofrío arms — crossed keys and book on green
